title: 第一卷 第4章 我风华正茂，你太小了
slug: 七零随军大院来了个软美人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

萧临戍压下想帮她擦眼泪的欲望，语气低沉带着温柔的诱哄：“反正你也要找对象，我也没有，不如我们重新认识一下，我叫萧临戍，草肃萧，未婚，二十六岁，每个月工资一百二十三，还有补贴票据不等。”

暗淡的眸子再次找到了主人，亮得惊人还有一丝不敢置信：“季，季望棉，彭城人，今年十八岁，高中学历。”

萧临戍眼中闪过一丝失落！

自己虽然正属于风华正茂，可是跟季望棉比起来，自己太老了！

季望棉一眼就看穿他的小心思，心里有些满意。

他要是仗着自己是军官，觉得自己是高攀，她转身就走，既然他表现出了失落……

亏欠是感情最好的润滑剂。

“原来你二十六了，挺好的，我妈说找年纪大的会疼人！”

季望舒低垂着头，露出最柔软的脖颈和羞红的耳根。

萧临戍满血复活，努力又努力压住嘴角：“你好，季望棉同志。”

季望棉看着眼前骨节分明的手，羞涩一笑，握住他的指头又快速抽离。

拇指轻轻划了一下。

“叫我棉棉就好，家里人都这么喊我！”

家里人？

原来他也算她的家里人，四舍五入，他们现在是夫妻了！

萧临戍搓了搓手指上的余温：“那个，你大伯呢？”

季望棉可怜兮兮：“他走了！”

“走了？”

萧临戍心里骂了几句。

什么长辈，这也太不负责任了，怎么能把小姑娘自己丢在这，万一自己是坏人呢！

季望棉捏住包裹一角：“萧大哥～我还是去住招待所吧！我要先跟父母说一声。”

“不行！”

萧临戍当即拒绝。

这张脸住在招待所，身边没有男人，太危险了！

“没关系，你就住在这里，你要是不放心，我可以现在就去打结婚报告，这样我们住在一起就名正言顺了！”

对上季望棉有些警惕的表情，萧临戍手忙脚乱的解释：“不，你别乱想，我真不是坏人，我就是怕影响你的名声，你放心，结婚报告下来也要大半个月，你要是觉得不合适随时可以离开。

而且我发誓，我绝对不会强迫你，我们一人住一间，如果你还不放心，我可以去住宿舍。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Xiao Linshu suppressed his desire to wipe her tears, and spoke in a low and gentle coaxing tone: "You have to find a partner anyway, and I don't have one either. Why don't we get to know each other again. My name is Xiao Linshu, Cao Suxiao, unmarried, twenty-six years old, with a monthly salary of 123, plus subsidy notes."

The dim eyes found their owner again, and they were astonishingly bright with a hint of disbelief: "Ji, Ji Wangmian, from Pengcheng, eighteen years old this year, with a high school education."

A trace of disappointment flashed in Xiao Linshu's eyes!

Although I am in my prime, compared with Ji Wangmian, I am too old!

Ji Wangmian saw through his little thoughts at a glance and felt somewhat satisfied.

If he relied on his status as an officer and felt that he was superior, she would turn around and leave. Since he showed disappointment...

Owe is the best lubricant of feelings.

"It turns out you are twenty-six, which is great. My mother said that if you find someone older, they will love you!"

Ji Wangshu lowered his head, revealing his softest neck and blushing ears.

Xiao Linshu was resurrected with full blood, and he tried his best to suppress the corners of his mouth: "Hello, Comrade Ji Wangmian."

Ji Wangmian looked at the knuckled hand in front of him, smiled shyly, held his fingers and quickly pulled away.

His thumb scratched lightly.

"Just call me Mianmian, that's what everyone in the family calls me!"

Family members?

It turns out that he is also part of her family, rounding things off, they are now husband and wife!

Xiao Linshu rubbed the remaining warmth on his fingers: "Well, where is your uncle?"

Ji Wangmian said pitifully: "He's gone!"

"Leaving?"

Xiao Linshu cursed a few times in his mind.

What elder, this is too irresponsible, how can you leave the little girl here by yourself, what if you are a bad person!

Ji Wangmian pinched the corner of the package and said, "Brother Xiao, I'd better go to the guest house! I want to tell my parents first."

"No!"

Xiao Linshu immediately refused.

This face lives in a guest house without a man around, it's too dangerous!

"It doesn't matter, you will live here. If you are worried, I can go get the marriage report now, so that it will be legitimate for us to live together!"

Regarding Ji Wangmian's somewhat wary expression last time, Xiao Linshu hurriedly explained: "No, don't think about it. I'm really not a bad person. I'm just afraid of affecting your reputation. Don't worry, it will take more than half a month to report the wedding. If you feel it's inappropriate, you can leave at any time.

And I swear, I will never force you. We will live in one room each. If you are not worried, I can live in the dormitory."
